verdict.rationale: Auth0 docs describe breached-password detection (block/notify on compromised credentials) and proactive blocking of suspicious IPs after consecutive failed logins to prevent brute-force/DDoS, plus MFA as an additional security layer — directly matching the credential-stuffing/brute-force protection story. However, there is no explicit documentation of bot/CAPTCHA detection specifics or independent/hands-on verification that these protections hold up in practice. Missing for 10: explicit bot-detection (e.g., CAPTCHA) documentation, independent third-party validation of attack-protection efficacy.
